description: This file defines a mock class DispatcherMock that implements the WPEFramework::PluginHost::ILocalDispatcher interface for testing purposes, utilizing Google Mock to mock methods related to dispatcher operations.

classes.name: DispatcherMock
classes.description: A mock class implementing the ILocalDispatcher interface for unit testing dispatcher behaviors.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Mocks the method for adding a reference count.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Mocks the method for releasing a reference count.

methods.name: QueryInterface
methods.description: Mocks the method for querying interfaces.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Mocks the method to activate a service.

methods.name: Deactivate
methods.description: Mocks the method to deactivate the dispatcher.

methods.name: Dropped
methods.description: Mocks the method indicating a dropped connection or callback.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Mocks the method to invoke a command on the dispatcher.

methods.name: Revoke
